name: Hotel Empire
tagline: build rooms, delight guests, count the cash

help.goal: Build a hotel guests want to stay in. Tycoon mode asks for $50k in 24 weeks; Relaxed cannot go bust.
steps: Tap an empty ＋ slot to build a room or a facility.
Set each room's nightly rate with the − and + buttons.
Add staff with + until the understaffed warning clears.
Tap ▶ Play week to run the week and read the report.
Spend spare cash on 🏗️ Add floor, ⭐ Reception or 📣 Advertise.
notes: Guests judge your rate against the fair price shown beside it.
Understaffed weeks sink your reputation, and reputation drives next week's demand.
Seasons swing demand: ☀️ high season fills the hotel, ❄️ off season empties it.
